programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.sub-title: The Age of the Steam Locomotive
programme.desc: Fred Dibnah explores the revolutionary impact of steam engines on rail transport. In the process, Fred examines both the earliest colliery railways and the end of steam power on commercial railways in the 1960s.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds, and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson unlocks the ancient roots of the Northumberland village of Warkworth. With the help of locals, he discovers clues that point back almost 1,000 years to the Norman conquest and how the invaders laid the foundations of a planned community, still visible to this day.

programme.title: Inside Classical
programme.sub-title: Halloween Spooktacular with BBC National Orchestra of Wales
programme.desc: Join presenter and musician Owain Wyn Evans for a concert full of Halloween tricks and treats. The BBC National Orchestra of Wales, conducted by Ellie Slorach, perform music that is guaranteed to give you a thrill.The concert includes Bach's gothic masterpiece Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Saint-Saëns Danse Macabre and the spine-tingling Rimsky Korsakov's arrangement of Mussorgsky's Night on the Bare Mountain.

programme.title: Inside Museums
programme.sub-title: St Fagans National Museum of History
programme.desc: St Fagans National Museum of History in Cardiff is home to more than 40 faithfully re-erected historical buildings. As a living history museum, it lives, breathes and embodies the culture and identity of Wales.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Autumnal fog and an overheating engine prove to be problems for narrowboater Robbie Cumming as he navigates a Roman waterway and the fast-flowing River Trent. It's a journey of many challenges as he runs aground and breaks down in Nottingham.

programme.title: The Good Life
programme.desc: Disaster follows disaster as Tom and Barbara find themselves pushed further and further into a corner.

programme.title: Yes, Prime Minister
programme.desc: Sir Humphrey has skilfully moved Dorothy Wainwright, the PM's political advisor, out of her office. She insists on moving back and tells Jim that he is letting Humphrey become too dominant.

programme.title: How the Celts Saved Britain
programme.desc: Dan Snow blows the lid on the traditional Anglo-centric view of history and reveals how the Irish saved Britain from cultural oblivion during the Dark Ages of 400-800AD. He follows in the footsteps of Ireland's earliest missionaries as they venture through treacherous barbarian territory to bring literacy and technology to the future nations of Scotland and England.

programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: An exploration of the attempt to blow up the Houses of Parliament in 1605, one of the most famous yet least understood events in British history. It shows how the plot was almost England's 9/11, and asks why a group of young Englishmen became so radicalised and so hell-bent on terrorism. Computer graphics recreate what the Houses of Parliament looked like in 1605, and show just how close the plotters came to success.

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.desc: Rich, distant and opulent, the jet set fascinated the public as they waved to us from airplane doorways before winging their way across the skies heading for yachts and exotic locations that the rest of us could only dream of. They were the aristocrats, the high fliers and high earners whose lives and loves fascinated us long before celebrity became a dirty word.

programme.title: The Making of King Arthur
programme.desc: Simon Armitage traces the evolution of the Arthurian legend through the literature of the medieval age and reveals that King Arthur is not the great national hero he is seen as. He's a fickle and transitory character who was appropriated by the Normans to justify their conquest.

programme.title: Olobobs

programme.title: Caru Canu a Stori

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hare didn't hop. He was one of the speediest animals in Tinga Tinga but none of the other animals wanted to race with him because Hare always won and it was becoming boring.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Cai a Megan yn edrych ymlaen at barti Calan Gaeaf, ond does dim pwmpen gyda nhw... eto. Cai and Megan are looking forward to a Halloween party, but they don't yet have a pumpkin!

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Cartwn hyfryd am gwdihw bach o'r enw Odo a'i ffrindiau yn y goedwig. A little owl called Odo and his woodland friends aim to combat the rise of anxiety in pre-school children by teaching them self-efficacy and to believe in themselves.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Mrs Moss wedi cyrraedd rownd derfynol gwobr Pennaeth Gorau Cymru. Mae Miss Enfys wedi rhoi Anni yng ngofal trefnu'r parti! Mrs Moss has reached the finals of the Best Welsh Head prize!

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Youssef yn galw Harri i ddweud fod sinc wedi torri yn y Cwtsh Newydd, Rhydaman. Mae Harri'n gneud dipyn o lanast yno! Youssef calls Harri to say that a sink has broken in Cwtsh Newydd!

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindiau

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Gwenllian sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Gwenllian join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland themed games.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Beth sy'n digwydd ym myd Guto Gwningen heddiw? What's happening in Guto Gwningen's world today?

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Pan mae Lili Lafant a Cwstenin Cranc yn uno, mae Jet-fab am eu trechu. Dysga Jetboi mai gwendid nid mantais yw derbyn cymorth. Jet-boy learns that receiving help is indeed not a weakness.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Signor Silvo, ffrind Syr Gwil, yn dod ar wyliau i'r parc, ac yn coginio'r pitsa perffaith. Signor Silvo, Syr Gwil's friend, comes on holiday to the park, and cooks the perfect pizza.

programme.title: Gerddi Cymru

programme.title: Dechrau Canu Dechrau Canmol

programme.title: Burton: Y Gyfrinach?
programme.desc: The untold story of a meeting between Richard Burton and his elder brother Ifor in Celigny in Switzerland in 1968. Against the backdrop of the Swiss countryside and Lake Geneva, the story revolves around the day of the meeting and its tragic consequences. The film explores the relationship between the two brothers and delves into the psyche of Burton himself and the possible reasons for his self-destruction.
